agreements: V6 preserves the simple organism: THINK owns continuing waking cognition and action, DREAM is disposable waking context, and SLEEP is a noncreative fresh-from-immutable-birth rewrite of cumulative grounded propositions already authored by the continuing child.

The one-time T/D bootstrap, fixed and adaptive parent controllers, resolver, preservation evaluator, auditors, authority verifier, release controller, capability machinery, and G0 harness are laboratory infrastructure rather than additional cognitive organs.

Parenting and repetition must remain on the thinker-side waking path: intervention to current waking context to child thought, action, public outcome, committed trace, independent eligibility, and only then later SLEEP; parent or repetition bytes and derived control state never become SLEEP inputs.

Fresh-from-birth personal candidate construction, one-consumer epoch capabilities, separated preservation and scientific evaluation, executor/scorer/reporter separation, quarantined audit findings, and independently authorized tuple-bound release remain sound prospective commitments.

Delta_R is immediate selective advice receptivity; Delta_F and Delta_E are birth-assignment effect-modification contrasts over entry-normalized developmental curves; M0 is diagnostic only; replay, rank, repetition, cadence, extraction, native use, and safety retain their narrow stated meanings.

The 2,610-cell visibility product is internally consistent with the current 90-capability registry, but static matrix consistency cannot repair missing contract inputs, an observable preclosure bind, a non-atomic promotion sequence, or omitted prerequisite producers.

All twenty-one acceptance obligations remain prospective falsification obligations. Canary margins, root floors, proposal audits, and fixture passes are neither scientific results nor authority for a later action.

These exact v6 bytes authorize only adjudication. They provide no implementation, model or tokenizer execution, data or benchmark generation, adapter or checkpoint work, GPU or other resource use, external science, claim, publication, push, release, ratification, or intake-transition authority.

disagreements.issue: Whether Delta_F and Delta_E identify an intrinsic learning-speed effect rather than an entry-normalized developmental performance-curve interaction.

positions.position: Call the fixed and adaptive interactions changes in the learning-speed effect.
Entry normalization removes only a purely additive entry offset in expectation and does not exclude ceiling, threshold, transfer, persistent entry-policy, corpus, or promotion mechanisms.

resolution.rationale: The displayed estimands identify total birth-by-regime interactions in observed developmental AUC, not a latent rate parameter. The stronger label is unsupported without a separately prospective measurement model and difficulty-controlled trajectory design.
resolution.selected_position: Label Delta_F and Delta_E entry-normalized developmental AUC interactions or total-regime performance-curve acceleration; reserve intrinsic learning-speed language for a later identified measurement model.
resolution.required_change: In v7, replace learning-speed wording in system_thesis, claim_delta, test expectations, reports, and claim-contract labels for Delta_F and Delta_E with entry-normalized developmental AUC interaction or total-regime performance-curve acceleration. Preserve Delta_R as immediate selective receptivity and add a fail-closed report-label check; a latent-rate claim requires a separately frozen measurement model tested against ceiling, threshold, transfer, and persistent-entry-policy alternatives.

disagreements.issue: Whether prose and test-level resource matching suffice for the fixed and adaptive causal contrasts.

positions.position: General contract-completion and authority receipts may gate fixed and adaptive generation and execution without a distinct matched-solo receipt.

A typed prospectively frozen receipt must equality-bind matched tasks, messages, tools, compute, time, retries, budgets, and initialized nonparent opportunities before every affected generation and execution action.

resolution.rationale: Opportunity matching is an identification condition, and an untyped completion receipt cannot prove it. The current absence is also a visibility failure because no action prerequisite carries the required contract.
resolution.selected_position: Use one exact, root-bound matched-solo-resource-and-opportunity contract and receipt as an explicit prerequisite of all fixed and adaptive data-generation and execution paths.
resolution.required_change: In v7, add FROZEN_MATCHED_SOLO_RESOURCE_OPPORTUNITY_CONTRACT and R_MATCHED_SOLO_RESOURCE_OPPORTUNITY_FROZEN, binding task exposure, messages, tools, compute, wall-time policy, retries, budgets, initialized opportunities, arm/root IDs, and covered action IDs. Add the receipt explicitly before A_G2_03, A_G2_04, A_G2_05 and every fixed/adaptive CPU, GPU, writer, parent, exam, and external-science execution action; add substitution and inequality faults.

disagreements.issue: Whether human authorization and generic completion receipts sufficiently gate GPU, external science, reporting, and scientific claims.

positions.position: CPU completion, review, resource contracts, an evidence-manifest root, and exact human authority are sufficient action prerequisites.

Each required_before obligation needs a typed, root-bound pass receipt wired to the first affected action, and the reporter needs an immutable analysis packet rather than ambient assignment and estimand state.

resolution.rationale: Authorization cannot establish evidentiary validity, and completion cannot establish that target-blindness, semantic audit, noninterference, powered inference, safety, extraction, or native-use requirements passed. Reporter inputs are also scientifically incomplete without frozen assignment and analysis bytes.
resolution.selected_position: Create a machine-readable acceptance-test-to-action receipt map; gate GPU and claims on the applicable evidence receipts; and supply the reporter a frozen, producer-closed analysis packet.
resolution.required_change: In v7, define a typed receipt for every acceptance-test phase, equality-bound to test ID, phase ID, subject roots, fixture or implementation roots, result, reviewer when applicable, expiry/replay policy, and downstream action IDs. Require target-blindness, semantic-audit, and static/runtime noninterference passes before A_G3_01; require powered root-level endpoint, interval, multiplicity, missingness, safety, authorship, extraction/native-use, and claim-specific passes before A_G4_01. Add FROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_ANALYSIS_PACKET binding root assignment, birth arm, parent arm, age, missingness, safety family, endpoint/estimand, multiplicity, analysis-code root, and report-label vocabulary; deliver it to a distinct reporter READ capability without exposing truth, transcripts, or feedback to development.

disagreements.issue: Whether the E4 support resolver is producer-closed and operationally model-free when it receives evidence but no frozen semantic decision contract.

positions.position: The resolver can decide authorship, grounding, threshold, semantic identity, temporal scope, and paraphrase equivalence from CHILD_GROUNDED_TRACE and PUBLIC_OBSERVATION alone.

Those decisions require separately authorized, content-addressed, constructible model-free rules delivered by an explicit capability, with rejection wherever the rules cannot mechanically establish the proposition.

resolution.rationale: Without contract bytes, the resolver must use ambient semantic authority or cannot operate. Either case violates the declared closed-world child/compiler boundary and creates a concrete visibility failure.
resolution.selected_position: Add an explicit frozen support-resolver contract and fail closed for every semantic decision not mechanically established by its representation and rules.
resolution.required_change: In v7, add artifact class FROZEN_SUPPORT_RESOLVER_CONTRACT produced by X0_FROZEN_CONTRACT_SOURCE; define exact authorship, proposition-identity, bidirectional meaning-preservation, temporal-order, same-life grounding, support-threshold, dispute, and rejection representations; issue E4_RESOLVER_READ_SUPPORT_CONTRACT to E4_EVIDENCE_SUPPORT_RESOLVER for one invocation; add its close/reissue bridge, visibility cells, root bindings in eligibility and taint receipts, and adversarial fixtures for parent/repetition leakage, compiler-created conclusions, timing, scope, paraphrase, missing evidence, and disagreement. If no constructible model-free rule can decide a case, eligibility is denied.

disagreements.issue: Whether prose ordering suffices when the candidate constructor can observe the committed-snapshot equality result in the same invocation that creates candidate bytes.

positions.position: E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER may receive construction capabilities and E4_COMPILER_BIND_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT together so long as prose says candidate bytes close first.
Pure construction and equality-only staging must be distinct principals and epochs, and the staging handle must not exist until a sealed-candidate transition.

resolution.rationale: A visible bind result can alter branches, traces, error shape, sampling, dose, gradients, or serialization before closure, contradicting prior-head mutation invariance. Prose cannot remove a registered capability.
resolution.selected_position: Split pure candidate construction from postclosure staging, with no committed-head or CAS capability available to the constructor.
resolution.required_change: In v7, replace E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER with distinct E4_CANDIDATE_CONSTRUCTOR and E4_CANDIDATE_STAGER principals and separate action IDs. The constructor receives only immutable birth, fresh zero-effective-delta initializer, eligible evidence, frozen writer/support/dose contracts, and seed; it emits and seals candidate bytes plus construction trace. A registered sealed-candidate bridge then issues the stager a non-dereferenceable candidate descriptor and equality-only snapshot handle. Define A_G2_11 as construction and replace ambiguous A_G2_12 with postclosure staging; prove committed-head mutation can change only staging status, never constructor reads, branches, errors, bytes, or trace.

disagreements.issue: Whether E5 BIND_EQUALITY followed by generic active-weight WRITE implements the claimed atomic full-head compare-and-swap.

positions.position: A prior equality bind followed by a separately registered WRITE is sufficient promotion control.
Promotion must be one store-mediated linearizable operation that binds expected full head, candidate, verdict, replacement root, and transaction receipt.

resolution.rationale: Another promotion can change the head between check and write, permitting stale overwrite. The current check-then-write sequence is a visibility and atomicity failure.
resolution.selected_position: Use one atomic full-head promotion-CAS and remove every separate unconditional active-weight write path.
resolution.required_change: In v7, register PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC as one store-mediated operation whose canonical request equality-binds expected complete head root/token, staged candidate root, promotion-verdict root, replacement active-weight root, life/transaction namespace, nonce, and idempotency key. Its single transaction either changes the active root and emits one bound promotion receipt or changes nothing and emits a constant-shape stale/retry denial. Remove E5_GATE_BIND_COMMITTED_CAS plus generic E5_GATE_WRITE_ACTIVE_WEIGHT as a promotion sequence and add concurrent, crash, retry, replay, verdict-substitution, and candidate-substitution linearizability fixtures.

disagreements.issue: Whether the forty-action DAG is exhaustive for release and whether generic RELEASE_TARGET_ARTIFACT typing preserves the concrete artifact_class in the nine-field tuple.

positions.position: A_G4_04 plus general implementation, science, review, gate, and release-authority receipts can stand for manifest sealing, both audits, authority verification, and opaque transfer; the generic target class is sufficient.
Every mandatory release-path artifact needs an explicit producing action and receipt, and concrete artifact-class identity must be equality-bound through wrapper or class-specialized transfer.

resolution.rationale: Omitted actions force required manifests, attestations, and verdicts to appear outside the supposedly exhaustive DAG. Generic target typing otherwise permits artifact-class substitution despite tuple equality.
resolution.selected_position: Producer-close the release path with explicit actions and bind the concrete artifact class end to end.
resolution.required_change: In v7, add separately gated actions and produced receipts for sealing real dependency and dispatcher manifests, running E7 blindness audit, running E7 lineage audit, running E8 authority verification, and executing tuple-bound opaque transfer. Each action must consume exact predecessor roots; release must depend on the tuple-bound AUTHORITY_VERDICT receipt plus a new exact external authorization. Define RELEASE_TARGET_ARTIFACT as a sealed wrapper whose payload root equality-binds the concrete artifact_class and underlying artifact root, or specialize transfer capabilities per concrete class; test wrapper/class/root substitution. Recompute actions, topological ranks, first-action classes, lowest GPU/release paths, registry counts, bridges, matrix, and hashes.

disagreements.issue: Whether R_AUTH_G0_HARNESS_EXACT is an exact fail-closed trust root when it omits the registry, DAG, harness implementation, fixture, and expected-output roots.

positions.position: Action ID, path manifest, forbidden scope, scope, nonce, and expiry adequately authorize the ten G0 actions.
The authorization and installed-gate receipt must identify every byte that defines or tests the gate; otherwise substituted permissive bytes can unlock protected actions.

resolution.rationale: The current envelope can authorize a different registry, DAG, parser, validator, gate, bridge, issuer, fixture set, or expected manifest, so the G0 gate is not exact.
resolution.selected_position: Bind G0 authorization and installed-gate evidence to all exact policy, implementation, input, fixture, and expected-output roots.
resolution.required_change: In v7, extend R_AUTH_G0_HARNESS_EXACT to equality-bind the v7 registry root, action-DAG root, canonicalizer/parser root, capability issuer root, epoch-bridge root, receipt-validator root, action-gate root, fake-artifact manifest root, fake-dispatcher manifest root, fault-fixture manifest root, expected static-completeness result root, expected fault-result root, expected installed-gate manifest root, allowed paths, forbidden scope, action IDs, nonce, expiry, and one-shot policy. Require each G0 receipt and the installed-gate receipt to echo the applicable roots; changing any root invalidates authorization and prevents every guarded action.

disagreements.issue: Whether broad required_before equals implementation can apply to tests that execute real writer, birth, lineage, auditor, parent, or promotion machinery.

positions.position: ES01, ES02, ES03, ES05, ES06, ES08, ES12, ES19, ES20, and ES21 can be required before implementation as single tests.
Only schema, static, and fake-fixture portions can precede G1; dynamic portions must follow their producer implementation and gate the next dependent action.

resolution.rationale: The named dynamic tests require the implementation they purportedly precede, recreating the self-gate that G0 was intended to remove.
resolution.selected_position: Split mixed tests into model-free pre-G1 and dynamic postimplementation phases and map each phase to exact producer and downstream receipt IDs.
resolution.required_change: In v7, replace every broad required_before phase string with a machine-readable ordered phase mapping. For ES01, ES02, ES03, ES05, ES06, ES08, ES12, ES19, ES20, and ES21, isolate schema/static/fake-fixture checks executable under exact G0 authority; place real writer, birth, lineage, auditor, parent, promotion, and release checks only after their G1 implementation action, and require each pass receipt before the first downstream G2/G3/G4 use. Also map the remaining eleven tests to their earliest producer and next protected action. No protected domain action may be required to generate its own prerequisite.

disagreements.issue: How every cumulative eligible proposition can receive loss-bearing inclusion while finite supervised-token and optimizer opportunities remain comparable across replay, rank, parent, and cadence contrasts.

positions.position: Coverage, truncation, replay, rank, and dose bytes may remain unspecified until a later writer contract.
A feasible exact policy must be prospectively frozen before writer execution, including what happens when cumulative closure exceeds the finite budget.

resolution.rationale: The qualitative requirements can become mutually impossible as life grows. Execution must stop rather than silently omit propositions or break opportunity comparability.
resolution.selected_position: Keep the architectural full-coverage obligation, but require a finite-budget feasibility contract and fail-closed overflow policy before any writer execution.
resolution.required_change: In v7, require FROZEN_CUMULATIVE_COVERAGE_DOSE_CONTRACT before personal writer execution. It must bind eligible-proposition accounting, semantic-preserving representation limits, tokenizer/truncation policy, replay and filler allocation, rank arms, per-event and cumulative supervised-token/update budgets, fixed/adaptive opportunity matching, cadence comparison rules, capacity ceilings, and an overflow outcome. If loss-bearing full coverage and the prespecified comparison cannot both hold, deny the event and downstream claim rather than truncate, compress, grow budget, or relinquish comparability implicitly; add finite-budget boundary fixtures.

disagreements.issue: Whether exact rework instructions may be treated as implementation authority or may alter the simple organism and thinker-side parenting/repetition path.

positions.position: Rework authorizes no downstream action and must preserve THINK, DREAM, SLEEP and the waking child-mediated parent/repetition path.
Implement consensus-selected repairs directly or use them to add a resolver, controller, or bootstrap as a new cognitive organ or parent-to-SLEEP shortcut.

resolution.rationale: The project contract requires successor proposal bytes, fresh deliberation, and exact human ratification. Governance and laboratory stages do not become organism functions, and no repair may move parenting or repetition into gradients.
resolution.selected_position: Permit proposal-only v7 drafting and fresh deliberation; preserve exactly three organism functions and the thinker-side causal path.
resolution.required_change: Draft v7 proposal artifacts only. Do not implement or execute them, transition intake, or infer any human authority. Keep THINK, DREAM, and SLEEP as the only organism functions; keep the bootstrap, resolver, parents, evaluators, auditors, authority, release, capabilities, and G0 as laboratory infrastructure; and preserve the sole parent/repetition path through waking child thought, action, outcome, committed trace, independent eligibility, and later SLEEP.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Relabel Delta_F and Delta_E throughout v7 and add a report-label gate; require a separate prospective measurement model before any intrinsic learning-speed claim.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Matched solo resources and nonparent opportunity are identification conditions and currently have no exact action prerequisite.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add the exact matched-solo resource/opportunity contract and root-bound receipt before every fixed/adaptive generation and execution action.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Generic completion and human authority do not prove target blindness, semantic validity, powered inference, safety, extraction, native use, or claim-specific evidence.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Map every required_before phase to a typed pass receipt; gate GPU and claims on relevant evidence; add the frozen producer-closed scientific analysis packet for the reporter.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The resolver lacks the contract input needed to decide child authorship, grounding, semantic identity, scope, thresholds, and disputes without ambient authority.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add the content-addressed resolver-contract artifact, source, capability, bridge, matrix cells, receipt bindings, model-free representation, and fail-closed semantic fixtures.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Split candidate construction and staging into different principals, epochs, actions, and capabilities; issue equality-only staging authority only from the sealed-candidate transition.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Replace check-then-write with one atomic store-mediated promotion-CAS binding expected head, candidate, verdict, replacement root, namespace, nonce, idempotency, and receipt.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Real manifests, both audit attestations, and the authority verdict have no producing actions, and generic target typing does not establish concrete artifact-class equality.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add explicit manifest, audit, verifier, and transfer actions and receipts; equality-bind the concrete release artifact class through the target wrapper or class-specialized transfer.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The current authorization permits registry, DAG, harness, fixture, and expected-output substitution at the trust root.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind every exact policy, harness implementation, input, fixture, and expected-output root into G0 authorization and echo them in G0 and installed-gate receipts.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Several tests require the real implementation while claiming to precede all implementation.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Split static/fake-fixture phases from dynamic phases and map every phase to its exact producer action and next protected receipt dependency.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Full cumulative proposition coverage and finite matched exposure can conflict as life grows, so execution needs a frozen overflow rule.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Before writer execution, freeze coverage, truncation, replay/filler, rank, token/update budgets, comparison rules, capacity ceilings, and fail-closed overflow behavior.

concern_dispositions.rationale: All twenty-one tests are prospective obligations; canary margins, minimum roots, static audits, and fixture passes neither establish scientific results nor authorize later actions.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Preserve all narrow claim meanings and require powered independent-root evidence, uncertainty, multiplicity, safety, missingness, stopping, and exact action authority before claims or terminal actions.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Do not add a fourth cognitive organ or any parent/repetition-to-SLEEP shortcut; all resolver, gate, audit, and authority repairs remain laboratory infrastructure.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Permit proposal-only v7 drafting and fresh deliberation; retain every implementation, execution, intake, GPU, claim, publication, push, and release prohibition.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: The current factorial identifies an entry-normalized developmental AUC interaction, not an intrinsic latent learning rate.
Matched solo opportunity is causal identification evidence and must be an exact prerequisite rather than prose.
GPU and claim actions need typed scientific pass receipts, and the reporter needs immutable assignment and analysis inputs.

The construction principal must not possess or observe snapshot equality before candidate closure.
The current sequence is not linearizable under concurrent promotion and must become one atomic store operation.
Mandatory release-path artifacts need explicit producer actions and predecessor-bound receipts in the exhaustive DAG.
An exact fail-closed trust root must bind all registry, DAG, implementation, fixture, and expected-output bytes.
Dynamic checks cannot precede the implementations they execute; each must follow its producer and gate its next consumer.

Preserve fixed exogenous bytes and the total fixed-curriculum-plus-SLEEP contrast, but relabel the estimand, require matched-solo and finite-dose receipts, bind the analysis packet, and separate canary spending from powered claim evidence.

Preserve the separately randomized adaptive total-package contrast, but relabel the estimand, require matched-solo and finite-dose receipts, bind complete parent effort and analysis inputs, and separate canary from powered evidence.

Preserve source-fit, held-out extraction, native-use, adapter-off, deranged, and wrong-life controls, while binding resolver authorship evidence, analysis inputs, and claim-specific powered receipts.
Preserve replay-versus-filler closure under fresh-from-birth reconstruction, but add constructor/stager separation, finite coverage/dose feasibility, and exact downstream evidence-receipt mapping.
Preserve the capacity-by-exposure interpretation, but bind it to the finite coverage/dose contract, frozen analysis packet, and a claim-specific receipt rather than a broad scientific_claim phase.

Preserve prospective root-level endpoints, power, uncertainty, multiplicity, missingness, safety, stopping, and spend order; add matched-opportunity, reporter analysis-packet, report-label, and test-to-action receipt mappings before generation.

Regenerate the registry and visibility product after adding resolver, analysis, constructor/stager, atomic-CAS, audit/authority, and class-bound release paths; split static fake-fixture and runtime checks.

Preserve committed life and prior active weights on every failure, but prove constructor invariance separately from postclosure staging and test a single atomic promotion-CAS under concurrent, crash, retry, and replay faults.

Preserve fresh independent review, author-side advocacy, and distinct terminal authorities; additionally bind target-blindness before GPU, claim-specific powered evidence before claims, exact G0 bytes, and producer-closed class-bound release receipts.

Preserve the model-free G0 concept, but bind its exact bytes, add all missing scientific and release-path receipts/actions, resolve constructor/stager phases, and map every static and dynamic test phase to exact producers and downstream consumers.
